name: Replit
verification_override: Replit pricing is not reliably extractable by automated tools. The pricing page defaults to annual billing with a JS-only toggle, and third-party web sources frequently show outdated prices. Do NOT change any existing prices. Only check for structural changes (new plans, removed plans, renamed plans) via WebSearch 'replit plans [current-year]'. If a new plan is found, add it with prices from 3+ agreeing sources. If no structural changes, report as verified with no edits. Static-HTML fetches return stale discount math (observed 2026-05-09: '20% off' badge in HTML vs 'Up to 10% off' on the live page); do not derive monthly prices from yearly + discount calculations. Maintainer-verified prices: $20/mo Core, $100/mo Pro (2026-05-09 screenshot).
